'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brad Eier LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brad Eier]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' you bet against rocky?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
